title: Traiana Trade Structure
description: JSON structure for a trade object processed through the Traiana Harmony network.

fields.name: tradeId
fields.description: Unique trade identifier assigned by Harmony.

fields.name: assetClass
fields.description: Asset class of the traded instrument.

fields.name: tradeDate
fields.description: Trade execution date in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: settlementDate
fields.description: Expected settlement date in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: notionalCurrency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the notional amount.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the trade in the Harmony lifecycle.

fields.name: matchTimestamp
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the trade was matched.
